content: Applications have to adhere to the following rules during multi block write requests for implicit synchronization between application and NVRAM manager: 1. The BSW Mode Manager issues the NvM_WriteAll request which transfers control to the NvM module. 2. The BS W Mode Manager can use polling to get the status of the request or can be informed via a callback function.
